name: io.github.Servosity/quotewerks-mcp
title: QuoteWerks MCP
description: Find, build and reprice QuoteWerks Web quotes with previews, plus margin and win-rate reports.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEWERKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: QuoteWerks Web API key, sent as the X-API-Key header. Create it in QuoteWerks Web under Setup > Options > Zapier and API (the API requires a user with MasterRights). Tick Allow write access only if the agent should create or change documents.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEWERKS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the API base URL. Leave blank for the default https://qwwapi.quotewerks.com.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEWERKS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to QuoteWerks Web. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEWERKS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly 1 (no other value) for a read-only MCP server: it drops sync, workflow archive, export, reports run, agent ask, agent report-draft, learnings forget and learnings reject, and refuses --confirm on docs create, items add, items reprice and requote, which can still preview. Local-only tools such as mirror and teach stay. The raw tables insert, update and delete tools are never offered over MCP. Leave blank for the full tool set.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEWERKS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not used by this connector: QuoteWerks Web has no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here limits nothing. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, give it a key without Allow write access.
